verdict.rationale: PlanetScale's in-product Insights computes query statistics, failing-query patterns, resource anomalies and schema recommendations from production traffic, and a user confirms the Insights tab surfaced missing indexes. However, nothing documents these as AI-generated. The AI layer comes mainly from external agents (Claude, Cursor, PlanetScale Bot) that reach Insights through the MCP server and skills, not from AI built into the product. Missing for 10: evidence of AI-generated insights natively inside the PlanetScale console, documentation of how the PlanetScale Bot surfaces in-product, independent corroboration of the AI-driven suggestion quality.
